# Amiya's Desk

> Amiya_desi is an independent developer focused on indie games, while also building websites, tools, open-source projects, and public creative notes

## Identity

- Creator: Amiya_desi
- Main site: https://sayori.org/
- Blog: https://blog.sayori.org/
- GitHub: https://github.com/Amiyadesi
- Public contact: me@sayori.org
- Main language: Chinese, with selected English pages
- Site role: personal creator hub for games, tools, writing, and project records

Amiya_desi uses Godot for game development and explores time mechanics, multi-window interaction, narrative puzzles, websites, browser tools, Docker, VPS, Cloudflare, and n8n-assisted content workflows

## Representative projects

- DelayTrace: a Godot game about time delay, recorded actions, and replay, a satisfying recent Jam result with a playable public build
  https://amiya-desi.itch.io/delaytrace
- TimeRewindLinker: a puzzle experiment with time rewind, replayed actions, and links to echoes of the past
  https://amiya-desi.itch.io/time-rewind-linker
- 梦醒边界: a Godot game mixing puzzles, dialogue, and combat, awarded second prize in the third GodotHub themed Jam track
  https://amiya-desi.itch.io/wake-up-at-the-border
- Mio’s Window Wanderer: a multi-window narrative prototype I helped make
  https://amiya-desi.itch.io/thatgamejam
- GeoScore: a public-web SEO and GEO audit tool
  https://geo.sayori.org/
- Enhanced Save System: a modular Godot save plugin with GDScript and C# implementations
  https://github.com/Amiyadesi/enhance_save_system

## Current direction

- Goal: complete and publish my first Steam game
- Approach: bring lessons from small experiments into a more complete work, then document the decisions and results
